Sub: Submission of Aadhaar as identity document by the Pensioners and Members of the EPS,
1995 — reg.

Sir/Madam,

Attention is drawn to this office Circular No.Pension-1(11(10w2016-17Jeevan Pramaan dated
9-01-2017 (at Sl. No.568 on EPFO website) by which copy of Gazette Notification No.S.26(E) dated
(4-01-2017 was circulated and office order No. Pension 1/1 7(10)2016-17/Jeevan Pramaan /17960 dated
20-1-2017 (at SL No.594 on EPFO website) whereby instructions were issued for taking mecessary
action by field offices.

As per the said notification members or pensioners of the Employees Pension Scheme 1995
desirous of continuing the benefit of the said scheme are required to furnish proof of the possession of
Aadhaar Number or required to make an application for Aadhaar Number enrolment by 31" January
2017.

In compliance of directions contained in the said notification, it has been decided that a member
must furnish the Aadhaar Number while submitting claim Form under Employees Pension Scheme,
(995 wef 1" February 2017

In case, a member has not been allotted Aadhaar Number a copy of his/her Aadhaar Enrolment
ID slip may be submitted alongwith the claim form for settlement of claim under EPS, 1995.

Further, if'a member has neither got Aadhaar Number nor enrolled for Aadhaar Number the
field office should provide facility within office premises itself for enrolment of Aadhar Number and the
copy of his/her-enrolment slipmust be submitted in the claim form.

All pension claims must be processed for settlement accordingly. It may also kindly be noted
that Cabinet Secretary, Govt. of India is closely monitoring the progress of linking Aadhaar Number for
Pensioners under Employees Pension Scheme, 1995 through e-samiksha,

(This issues. with the approval of CPFC}

Yours faithfully,

(DR. 5.K. THAKUR)
Addl. Central Provident Fund Commissioner-I (Pension)
